name: Zabytyj Pioner
source: Semyon, stuck in the camp for another cycle, finally decides to ask its inhabitants for answers to the questions that may finally shed some light on his entrapment. Since asking politely didn't work in the past, he decides to do it in a rather monstrous form this time. Everything quickly goes much worse than he expected, and very quickly, Semyon starts losing his humanity, touch with reality, as well as any hope of getting the answers he so desired.
